title: We built an Ubuntu mirror and then made it faster
summary: Depot built an S3-backed Ubuntu mirror and tuned apt and dpkg to cut median package installation time from 19 seconds to 3 seconds. Common setup work now takes less time.
body_markdown: The new mirror removed network slowdowns, but most of the remaining time came from local disk work and defaults designed for persistent machines. Depot tuned` apt` and` dpkg` for ephemeral runners, including disabling unnecessary` fsync` calls with` --force-unsafe-io` .
